capabilities.description: Builds a STRIDE-based threat model: trust boundaries, attack surface inventory, and mitigations.
Classifies a finding by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with exploitability and blast radius.
Reviews an authorization model (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC) for least-privilege and default-deny gaps.
Audits third-party dependencies for known CVEs, maintenance health, and typosquatting risk.
Drafts a triage/containment/root-cause playbook for a specific incident scenario.
